(()=>{const idx=D.findIndex(d=>d._key==='autumn');PT8.launch({mode:'mp',rally:true,track:idx,laps:1,humans:[{id:'ford',alt:0}],ai:[]});const Rc=RACE;Rc.state='race';Rc.green=true;const c=Rc.cars.find(q=>q.human);c.forceAI=true;window._c=c;for(let s=0;s<1800;s++)step(1/60);const T=Rc.T,X=T._bx;const near=[];for(const g of X.segs){const d=Math.min(Math.hypot(g[0]-c.x,g[1]-c.z),Math.hypot(g[2]-c.x,g[3]-c.z));if(d<8)near.push(['seg',g.map(v=>+v.toFixed(1)),+d.toFixed(1)])}for(const p of X.pts){const d=Math.hypot(p[0]-c.x,p[1]-c.z);if(d<8)near.push(['pt',p.map(v=>+v.toFixed(1)),+d.toFixed(1)])}const i=c.idx;return JSON.stringify({ty:T.y[i],gy:T.terr&&T.terr(c.x,c.z),vy:c.vy,yaw:c.yaw,psi:T.psi[c.idx],respT:c.respT,exp:c.exp,fin:c.fin,keys:Object.keys(c).filter(k=>/stuck|rec|flip|wreck|dead|tow|lock/i.test(k)).map(k=>k+'='+c[k]),x:c.x,z:c.z,y:c.y,i,sp:c.sp,hw:T.hw[i],near:near.slice(0,30),tx:T.x[i],tz:T.z[i]})})()
